# Contributing

Smart Mark is closed-source (All Rights Reserved). This repository is a community
hub for bug reports, feature requests, and the privacy policy -- there is no source
code here and pull requests are not accepted.

## How to help

Report a bug:
- Open an issue using the Bug report template.
- Include your Chrome version, OS, and steps to reproduce.
- Attach a screenshot or screen recording if possible.

Suggest a feature:
- Open an issue using the Feature request template.
- Describe what you want and why it is useful.
- Keep in mind Smart Mark is keyboard-driven -- suggestions that require mouse
  menus or toolbar clicks are unlikely to be added.

Report a security vulnerability:
- Do not open a public issue. See SECURITY.md for the private reporting process.

## What gets built

Feature decisions are made by the maintainer. Opening an issue is the best way to
propose something, but there is no guarantee every suggestion will be implemented.
High-quality, well-described issues are more likely to be acted on.
